customer_john: Hey team — after rotating our SSO service key last night our app started getting 403s on /v1/generate. Embeddings requests still succeed. Example error: `403 Forbidden: token missing scope "inference.generate"`. Anyone seen this?

marie_cs: Sorry to hear that — can you paste the failing curl and the full error body (no secrets)? Also which key type (org/service/oauth) did you rotate?

customer_john: curl snippet: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" -d '{"model":"redwood-l1","input":"hi"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate`
Response: `{"error":{"message":"Forbidden","code":403,"details":"missing scope: inference.generate"}}`
We rotated an SSO-provisioned service key (created by our IdP connector).

marie_cs: Thanks. Can you run this for me and paste output? `ri-cli auth inspect --token <REDACTED>` — it'll list scopes encoded in the token. If you can't run cli, paste the base64 header+payload of the token and I can decode.

customer_john: Pasted output (redacted):
```
sub: svc_abc123
iss: sso.company.com
scopes: ["embeddings.create","embeddings.search","rerank.read"]
exp: 1720016000
```
No inference scopes present.

marie_cs: OK that matches the 403 — token lacks inference.generate. Embeddings routes work because embeddings scopes are present.

sam_platform: FWIW we recently changed the role-to-scope mapper in the idp-provisioner. There's a new role name `llm-infer` but the mapping in prod didn't include it, only the old `inference` role. If the connector issued a token based on role names and the customer's IdP uses the new role, the provisioner drops inference scopes.

jing: Can you confirm whether the SSO mapping job logged a warning? Check `/var/log/idp-provisioner/provisioner.log` around the rotation time for messages like `unmapped role: llm-infer`.

customer_john: Found this in the logs: `WARN unmapped role llm-infer for svc_abc123 — skipping scope assignment`. That sounds like it.

marie_cs: Root cause looks like the provisioner mapping mismatch. Short-term workarounds: 1) create a manual service key from Console (Settings -> API keys) which has all inference scopes; or 2) ask your IdP admin to add the legacy `inference` role to the user/service so provisioner picks it up. Both will restore generate calls immediately.

derek_eng: We'll patch the provisioner mapping to include `llm-infer` and add a fallback for unmapped roles so it doesn't silently drop scopes. I'll open a PR and tag the change for canary deploy. ETA for canary: ~2 hours, full rollout after validation.

sam_platform: Also adding an observability alert to catch tokens without any inference scopes attempting to call /v1/generate — will surface earlier.

auth-bot: Ticket created: #CS-4872 — Assigned to derek_eng. Severity: P2. Links: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-4872

marie_cs: I've emailed the customer with the two workarounds and asked them to confirm which they'd prefer. john — if you want, you can create a console key and I can validate it from our side before you switch.

customer_john: I'll try the console key for now and report back. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

marie_cs: Great — please ping here after you validate. We'll keep the ticket open until the provisioner fix is live and we verify new rotations work. :white_check_mark:
